arxiv-2402-08578.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising solution in Edge Computing (EC) environments to process the proliferation of data generated by edge devices. arxiv-2507-20947.title: Entanglement negativity in free fermions: twisted characteristic polynomial, universal bounds, and area laws
arxiv-2507-20947.creator: Ryota Matsuda, Zongping Gong
arxiv-2507-20947.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ryota Matsuda, Zongping Gong. We present a general and simple formula for computing the entanglement negativity in free fermions. Our formula allows for deriving several universal bounds on negativity and its rate of change in dynamics. The bound on negativity directly relates the clustering property of correlations in free-fermion states to the entanglement area law, and provides the optimal condition for the area law in mixed free fermion states with long-range correlations.

arxiv-2509-07678.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by X. Pérez-Couto, S. Torres, E. Villaver, A. J. Mustill, M. Manteiga. 3I/ATLAS is the third interstellar object discovered to date, following 1I/‘Oumuamua and 2I/Borisov. Its unusually high excess velocity and active cometary nature make it a key probe of the Galactic population of icy planetesimals. Understanding its origin requires tracing its past trajectory through the Galaxy and assessing the possible role of stellar encounters, both as a potential origin and a perturber to its orbit.

pmc-10656797.creator: Tamer Mohamed Elsherbiny
pmc-10656797.description: Hyperparathyroidism (HPTH) is the third most common endocrine disorder. Hypovitaminosis D affects up to 40% of the general population and about a third of hyperparathyroid patients. Such a combination may alter the classic presentation of HPTH. This report presents a premenopausal female with long history of osteoporosis, normocalcemia, and hypovitaminosis D who was initially diagnosed as secondary HPTH.

pmc-11441079.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPrevious studies have reported the link between hypoxic conditions and NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pulpal inflammation in the progression of pulpitis. However, the underlying mechanism has not been fully elucidated. This study aimed to investigate the role of HIF-1α in the regulation of NLRP3 inflammasome pathway via NF-κB signaling under hypoxic conditions with or without LPS in human dental pulp fibroblasts (HDPFs) during the progression of pulpitis.MethodsHIF-1α plasmids or siRNAs were used to upregulate or downregulate HIF-1α in HDPFs, respectively.
